profile.headline: Cyber Software Engineer @ ICR
profile.summary:
I am a Cyber Software Engineer @ ICR; I have a B.S in Computer Science with an emphasis in Information Security. I am hard-working and determined. My work is passion-driven and in-depth.

Skills: 
- Communication
- Natural Leadership
- Problem Solving
- Organization
- Perseverance
- Analytical Skills
- Computer Science
- Mathematics

Strengths:
- Programming (C, C++, Python, Agile Development, x86 Assembly, Java, Go)
- Android Development
- Analyzing Algorithms
- Navigating Linux and Windows
- Navigating Command Line
- Leading a Team
- Passion-driven
- Network Security
- Ethical Hacking
- Reverse Engineering
- Machine Learning
- Computer Vision
- Big Data
- Software Architecture 

Please reach out to me at:
claude.torres@western.edu
